source_title: Spectris plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 109 and 160 state that the financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors on 19 February 2020; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Sales rose 1.7% to £1,632.0m, adjusted operating profit 4% to £258.1m, margin from 15.5% to 15.8% and cash conversion reached 91%; disposals moved net debt of £297.1m to £33.5m net cash. However, Omega like-for-like sales fell 9%, its profit and margin deteriorated sharply, and Group restructuring costs increased to £52.2m across portfolio and site actions.
already_announced_exclusion: The HBK integration, Omega and CLS restructuring, site closures, portfolio rationalisation, disposals and £52.2m restructuring programme disclosed or implemented before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Explicit and sizeable restructuring and weakness at Omega create meaningful pressure, but Group sales, profit and margin growth, strong cash conversion and a move to net cash provide powerful quantified offsets.

source_title: Spectris plc Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 69, 129 and 191 state that the reports and financial statements were approved by the Board on 23 February 2022; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Like-for-like sales rose 10%, adjusted operating profit 21% to £209.4m and adjusted margin from 13.0% to 16.2%, while statutory operating profit recovered from a loss to £154.9m. Cash conversion was 96% and year-end net cash £167.8m. Reported sales fell 3% because of disposals and currency, while supply-chain constraints delayed some fourth-quarter sales and £11.9m of restructuring cash costs were paid.
already_announced_exclusion: The Millbrook, Brüel & Kjær Vibro, ESG Solutions and NDC Technologies disposals, HBK restructuring and other portfolio actions disclosed or completed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Supply-chain disruption and residual restructuring were limited; double-digit organic sales growth, sharply higher profit and margins, strong cash conversion and substantial net cash dominate the evidence.

source_title: Spectris plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: Annual report pages 79, 130, 140 and 192 state that the reports and financial statements were approved by the Board on 28 February 2024; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Sales rose 9% to £1,449.2m, including 10% like-for-like growth; adjusted operating profit rose 18% to a record £262.5m and margin from 16.8% to 18.1%. Cash conversion reached 103%, return on gross capital employed 18.5% and year-end net cash remained £138.8m after acquisitions and buybacks. Both core divisions increased sales, profit and margins, with restructuring cash costs only £1.4m.
already_announced_exclusion: The Red Lion disposal, completed portfolio rationalisation, four acquisitions and investments, and residual restructuring payments disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Record profit, double-digit organic growth, broad margin expansion, cash conversion above 100% and substantial net cash provide strong and consistent evidence against restructuring pressure.
